 report['packageChecks'].append({'package':name,'licenseMatchesPin':True,'existingFilesCompared':len(files),'changedExistingFiles':changed})
row=m['skills'][0];source=row['upstreamPath']+'/playbooks/trace-forensics.md';local=row['localPath']+'/playbooks/trace-forensics.md';a=upstream(row['adaptedFrom'],source);b=(root/local).read_text()
